IMF Lowers Global Growth Forecast, Cites West Asia Risks

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has revised its global economic growth forecast downwards for 2026 to 3%, citing lingering risks from the West Asia conflict. Despite the global slowdown, some reports indicate the IMF still projects strong growth for India, with AI also noted as a factor mitigating the war's economic impact.
